Hymn 30: Come, Come, Ye Saints
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: English folk song
Lyricist/Text Author: William Clayton
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 30 titled "Come, Come, Ye Saints" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by English folk song and the lyrics were written by William Clayton.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
